text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Got it.
The pace, the timing to make my move—I see it all now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: In this race, nothing less than victory is acceptable.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“A comment befitting a winner.
Come up with something good,
all right?”
